title: MSR5: sharper streaming-sieve time and source coefficients

claims.statement: For MSR5 in proof.md, label-tools.md and gradient-tools.md, for every N>=2 and fixed s modulo N let n=ceil(log2 N). Use its exact finite branch for n<1048576 and its specified large-branch integer/rational parameters, constant-weight leaves, multiway product rank/recompute instrument, extra known-frequency root and counted classical grid estimator and source-only all-moduli recovery. Unconditional entire-secret success exceeds 2/3. On EVERY branch the SAME program has total charged sequential work T=O(n^10*2^((161/128)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all other resource guarantees and the clean count law. All constants are absolute with fixed n=1 time/sample bounds. Every initialization, preparation, controller/gate/address operation, failed filter/leaf/merge/root, reset and cleanup is charged. There is no2^t solution table, free QRAM, source inverse or uncounted original-incidence register. The exact growth index of this envelope is 1/2.

Every acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state. Under this promise unconditional full-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch, including source/work-clock aborts.
